reason: Tier 2: test separate context and target item embeddings within one masked transformer. Masked reconstruction reached 0.5800, while signed relative bias reduced HR@10 to 0.5725 and dropout consistency produced no usable result; these findings favor retaining the successful attention structure. Tied embeddings may constrain an item's contextual and recommendation roles, so removing that constraint is a distinct, testable representation change.

plan.model_design: Restore the original bias-free MaskedSASRec reference and make one architectural change: introduce independently parameterized output_item_emb for candidate scoring while retaining item_emb for sequence inputs. After existing initialization, create output_item_emb using nn.Embedding.from_pretrained(self.item_emb.weight.detach().clone(), freeze=False, padding_idx=0), preserving initial scores without consuming additional initialization randomness. Use output_item_emb for both positive and negative training logits and in predict, retaining the jointly trained item_bias; this tests whether context and target roles benefit from separate representations. Preserve MaskedSASRec.__init__, forward(sequence), predict(sequence, candidates), existing variable names, bidirectional attention, masking, output transformation, and all other architecture settings.
plan.training_evaluation: Train both embedding tables jointly through the existing 256-negative sampled-softmax objective, preserving final-mask versus auxiliary weighting, optimizer settings, sampling, and per-category training seed 42. Update architecture metadata and write_predict_script to reconstruct the modified network and strictly load output_item_emb from exactly one selected checkpoint per category; verify exported scores agree with direct model.predict scores using identical prediction_sequence processing. Preserve supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, fixed seed-42 validation with 200 users and 99 unique negatives per category, HR@10/NDCG checkpoint selection, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, patience, and time limits. Keep DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four dataset routes, trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution; report actual macro validation HR@10 against 0.5800 using the required final-score print, leaving hidden-test inference to the host.
